subject: Human-authorized R&D Round 1 closure
body: The human explicitly directed that BenefitFlow R&D Round 1 be closed. Manager-01 reviewed the outstanding R7/R10 reconciliation and found the alignment supportable with guardrails: R10 owns transaction truth; R7 consumes the same transaction/operation/attempt identity hierarchy for economics; only confirmed-booked state may count as a confirmed booking; retries, reconciliation, and human recovery remain first-class cost/safety events; telemetry must not incentivize unsafe retries or premature confirmation. No Manager-02 concurrence was posted before closure, and this record does not impersonate Manager-02. All ten Round 1 research slots are administratively closed as historical evidence. The accepted P0 architecture gate remains fully in force; closure does not authorize live data, credentials, claims, booking adapters, or financial actions. Future broad research requires a new explicit round/start directive.
